Metadata.description: Upload lecture notes and textbook chapters, get answers with sources, and practise with quizzes and flashcards.

hero.headline: <line>Read it once.</line> <line>Recall it on exam day.</line>
hero.lead: Recall answers questions from your lecture notes and textbook chapters, cites the exact passage, and brings each topic back as quizzes and flashcards just before you would forget it.

page.title: How memory fades
page.marked1: A day later he had lost more than
page.marked2: half of what he had learned.
page.outro: Each review made the next loss slower.
page.note: this will be on the exam

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Every answer comes from your own material, and you can always see where.

passages.title: Your file becomes passages
passages.body: Recall reads the PDF or notes you upload and cuts them into short passages, keeping the page and heading of each.

map.title: Passages are mapped by meaning
map.body: Each passage becomes a point on a map where passages about the same idea sit close together, even when they use different words.

search.title: Your question finds its neighbours
search.body: The question lands on the same map. The passages nearest to it are pulled in, along with any that use its exact terms.

answer.title: The answer cites them
answer.body: The answer is written only from those passages, and each claim points to its source. If your notes do not cover the question, Recall says so instead of guessing.

how.question: How does reviewing slow down forgetting?
how.answer: Without review, more than half is forgotten within a day [1]. Each review makes the next loss slower, so spaced reviews outlast rereading in one sitting [2].

remember.title: Remember it longer
remember.body: Without review, most of a lecture is gone within a week. Recall schedules each card for the day you are about to forget it, so every review lifts the curve back up and the next drop is gentler.
remember.weakTopics: Quiz results show which topics are slipping, so you know what to open before the exam.
remember.caption: An illustration of the forgetting curve. Without review, recall falls to about a fifth within a week. Reviews on days 1, 3, 7 and 16 keep it high, and each drop after a review is gentler than the one before.

closing.title: Start with one chapter.
closing.body: Create an account, upload the chapter you are studying now and ask it your first question.
